$comment: AI-rendered reference photos of the stock products (D-426): one per look, generated with Google Stitch (Gemini image), blank packaging on white; sizes of one look share a photo. Placed with `pnpm catalog:product-photos public/media/stock/manifest.json --confirm --as <staff>` (each SKU in `skus` gets the photo as its first image). A real photograph replaces a render through the admin (source `getpack`); the script never replaces a photo of another source.
